UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated Apex Tech user profile with verified email status and system role.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

emailVerified.description: Whether the user's email address has been verified.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when account was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated.

AdminMarker.title: AdminMarker
AdminMarker.description: Marker document indicating administrative privileges for a specific UID.

ConnectionCheck.title: ConnectionCheck
ConnectionCheck.description: Read-only health check document for verifying Firestore connectivity.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profiles containing PII (email, fullName); readable and writable only by the owning user or an admin.

/admins/{userId}.description: Admin role registry; readable only by the owning user or existing admins, writable only by admins.
